h:
这是一个非常有用的实验，所以我决定分享这个设置。

操作原理：您可以定义颜色渐变并编码为潜在变量，而不是使用空潜在变量作为起点。这使您可以更好地控制图像中的调色板并具有更大的灵活性。根据您的艺术偏好，使用降噪来找到您喜欢的良好值。

最后有一个小部分在图像上分层渐变，增加颜色。

如果您使用此设置进行重新采样，则可能需要将潜伏一起分析并在沿着管道向下移动时调整渐变大小，否则大多数/所有颜色数据将丢失，这违背了使用此设置的目的。

o.en:
This was an experiment that ended up being very useful, so I decided to share the setup.

Principals of Operation: Instead of using an empty latent as the starting point, you can define a color gradient and encode to latent instead. This gives you much greater control and flexibility over the color palette in the image. Play with denoise to find a good value that you like based on your artstic preferences.

There is a little section at the end that layers the gradient over the image, increasing the color.

If you do re-samlping with this setup, you will likely need to slerp the latents together and resize the gradient as you go down your pipeline, or else most/all of the color data will be lost, which defeats the purpose of using this.
